text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Dairy Company says unrestricted import of foreign products posses a threat to national dairy industry.
- Defence minister receives message from Russian counterpart.
- French troops arrive in Kuwait for joint military exercise.
- Kuwait keen to invest in Tunisian tourism industry.
- Visiting Jordanian official calls for speedy solution to the issue of detainees. Kuwait says about 600 Kuwaitis are still held in Iraq since its 1990-91 occupation.
- Foreign minister says he received message from Jordanian Prime Minister Kabariti.
- Defence lawyer denys spy charge against Kuwaiti woman. Court's verdict expected November 26.
